injuries.description: Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressed Mood
source: Dr Wongs diagnosis was that as a result of the Incident, the plaintiff suffered from Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressed Mood.
Physical examination at The Kwong Wah Hospital showed mild tenderness at lower back.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: mild bruising over left upper arm
source: Physical examination showed mild bruising over left upper arm.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: nightmares of people chasing her and grabbing her
weakness of both lower limbs; could walk only slowly and needed to take frequent rests
mild bruising over left upper arm

treatments_received: treatment at The Kwong Wah Hospital (A&E)
treatment at West Kowloon Psychiatric Centre
treatments_future: 18 months psychiatric treatment with weekly one-hour sessions in the first three months, fortnightly one-hour sessions in the second three months and monthly one-hour session for the remaining 12 months (Dr Wongs recommendation)
30 one-hour sessions with Dr Tam (as noted by the court)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: She stopped reading books, listening to music and swimming; no longer interested in these things after the Incident
She did not want to meet people and stopped socializing with her friends after the Incident; ceased socializing

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: She was so frightened that she confined herself to her flat for a few days after the Incident and moved out from the Building to avoid contact with the 1st defendant
